name: l0_runtime_decal
about: `CDecal::Spawn` 0x1023a750, its unnamed projector `FUN_1023aa30` 0x1023aa30 and the named path's `CDecal::Use` 0x1023a7d0 (`walks/L0-r011.md`), over four `infodecal`s created at runtime (a map row's Spawn runs the same bodies at Load; the two witness maps carry only unnamed, flagless infodecals). The `texture` key (`CDecal::vfunc110` 0x1023adb0) writes `m_nTexture` (+0x450) = `PrecacheDecal`'s index, never negative; a decal with no key keeps the calloc 0, a VALID index. Spawn: `m_nTexture < 0` and the multiplayer arm (`gpGlobals->+0x30`, 0 in single player, with spawnflag 0x800) remove; `m_iName == 0` tail-jumps to the projector; a named decal gets `m_pfnThink` = 0x1000572c (a bare `ret`) through `ThinkSet(NULL context)` -- `m_flNextThink` untouched, nothing scheduled -- and `m_pfnUse` = 0x1000c888, then waits. Projector: `CTraceFilterValidForDecal` (passes over `weapon_*`, `item_*`, `prop_ragdoll/dynamic/static/physics`, else `CTraceFilterSimple`), `GetAbsOrigin`, the box `o +- 5` units, `Ray_t::Init(min, max)` -- a LINE along the diagonal -- traced with mask 0x200400b; a miss or a world hit (edict 0) submits `StaticDecal(world origin, m_nTexture, 0, 0)`; a hit on another entity submits `(VectorITransform(origin, m_rgflCoordinateFrame), m_nTexture, eidx, model)` -- `dec_npc`'s line runs into the NPC's hull from outside; then `SUB_Remove` 0x101c0b10 (no health warning at 0) -> `UTIL_Remove` 0x101cd940: the `removed` kind names it. Use: `GetOrigin` (local), mask 0x400b, `CTraceFilterSimple`, `IndexOfEdict(m_pEnt)` with no null test (a solid under `dec_named` keeps retail from faulting), a `CTEBSPDecal` broadcast to all players `(0.0, local origin, eidx, m_nTexture)` -- no StaticDecal, no model, no local transform -- then `ThinkSet(SUB_Remove)` and `m_flNextThink = curtime + 0.1`: removed 0.1 s after Use. Reported as `fail`, a stored word, a submit or a removal time differs from retail's.
